# Results summary

*Generated by `analysis/make_results_summary.py` from `results/tables/`; do not edit by hand. Single seed (42) unless a multi-seed table is present.*

## Data
Train part: 2,250 posts (44.7% extremist). Test part: 749 labelled posts (16.4% extremist). SHA-256 of the data file: `ea585a13cbdf93c0398be75a2149c0744c7cbec598f3d55597473c8924e36744`.

## Main result: DATE on the held-out test posts
| Metric | Single fold models (mean +- sd) | 10-model ensemble |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy | 0.8230 +- 0.0363 | 0.8425 (95% CI 0.8144-0.8678) |
| Macro-F1 | - | 0.7437 |
| ROC-AUC | - | 0.8626 |
| PR-AUC (extremist) | - | 0.6299 |
| Balanced accuracy | - | 0.7751 |
| ECE (15 bins) | 0.0640 | 0.0304 (95% CI 0.0226-0.0600) |
| Brier score | 0.2620 | 0.2281 |
| NLL | 0.4200 | 0.3627 |

Ensemble minus mean single-model ECE: -0.0289 (95% CI -0.0458 to -0.0100). 10-fold cross-validation (single models): accuracy 0.8222 +- 0.0270.
